posts.title: Rune Haven website v1
body: The alpha website now has wallet sign-in, a player dashboard, a land marketplace, a leaderboard and live server status.
Sign in with Phantom to see your characters, inventory, VGLD balance and land. Your wallet address is your in-game account.

posts.title: Invite-only alpha
body: Alpha access is limited to approved Solana wallets. Approved players can download the launcher from the home page.
